[center][size=6][b]JunimoGate[/b][/size]
[size=4]Android Mod Launcher for Stardew Valley with Integrated SMAPI[/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

JunimoGate is an open-source Android Mod launcher for Stardew Valley with an integrated SMAPI runtime.

It brings game launching, Mod management, save management, backups, and diagnostics together in one Android app. The interface is available in English and Simplified Chinese.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Download the JunimoGate ZIP from the [b]Files[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP and install the included APK.[/*]
[*]Allow installation from your browser or file manager if Android requests permission.[/*]
[*]Open JunimoGate and follow the on-screen setup.[/*]
[*]Import your Mods and launch Stardew Valley through JunimoGate.[/*]
[/list]
JunimoGate is an Android application and is not installed through Vortex.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Integrated Android SMAPI runtime[/*]
[*]Mod archive importing[/*]
[*]Installed Mod version management[/*]
[*]Mod search, groups, and enable controls[/*]
[*]Mod sharing[/*]
[*]Save import, export, and backups[/*]
[*]Launcher and SMAPI logs[/*]
[*]Faster routine launches after the initial setup[/*]
[*]English and Simplified Chinese interfaces[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley installed on an Android device[/*]
[*]Enough free storage for the game workspace, Mods, saves, and backups[/*]
[*]Permission to install the JunimoGate APK[/*]
[/list]
No separate SMAPI installation is required.
[list]
[*]Join the [url=https://discord.gg/q29GT4Vh6]JunimoGate Discord community[/url] to connect with other users, exchange ideas, and get community support.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Thanks to the SMAPI and Android modding communities, Mod authors, contributors, and everyone supporting JunimoGate.
